interpretationNotes: Historical collages retain the dates and wording from the customer concept; they are customer illustrations, not independent historical evidence.
Workshop images include a rendered niche. Runtime contentCrop selects only the central subject and excludes the depicted architectural frame and floor.
Eight craft-to-niche positions are a web presentation assignment. The exact physical craft order is not documented in the concept.
Kalyazin is captioned as Kalyazin in Tver region, never as a photograph of Tver city.
Only Vladimir, Suzdal and Kalyazin photographs identify a real pictured place. Other named city selections use clearly captioned thematic imagery.
No low-resolution volga-windows previews are stretched over the new large surfaces.
